numerical.scope: Owned outputs of actual native calls; no extra solve or independent QP reconstruction

native_prefix.scope: Descriptive prefix through last normal actual send; not a complete-task acceptance

diagnostic_sender.scope: raw received snapshot/proposal CDR and moved actual native call outputs; JSON and file writes on bounded auxiliary recorder only

limitations: The prefix ends at the last normal actual send, not at the requested task end.

Native acceptance flags describe recorded core output; original full qualification remains separate.
